scope: Two FP16 E2E comparison charts; not a revalidation of all historical isolated operator or W8A16 data.
model: Qwen2.5-0.5B FP16 IR; GPU default inference precision, NPU f16 hint
inputs: Identical numpy seed 20260903; prompt W and 32 fixed decode inputs.
timer: Whole prefill + 32 decode infer calls, including Python feed and first decode. Reset/compile/warmup/output summaries excluded from latency.
throughput: (W+32)/request_seconds; processed-input work rate, NOT output-generation speed or concurrency throughput.
energy: Median of 3 process-level means: separate 5-request RAPL psys windows minus contemporaneous 8.617 W idle. Includes state reset/output-summary CPU work, unlike latency timer.
uncertainty: Whiskers are range of 3 process medians (energy: process means), not confidence intervals.
correctness_scope: Final-step logits vs same-window GPU r1; not all positions, CPU reference, or language-model quality.
oracle_status: WITHDRAWN at all windows. Cannot claim fused optimal latency or energy from invalid/mixed-runtime isolated traces.
